events.text: You are a peasant. You have worked your old friend's farm for twenty-five years.
One morning, as you cut barley in the low field, a host of the king's guard rides through the standing crop as though it were water.
They tell you the king has called every man between twenty-two and thirty-five to the Dark Mountain. You have seven days to reach Hagan's Castle.

events.name: drizzle
events.text: A thin rain starts — not enough to shelter from, enough to soak you.
Fenmoor
Six houses, a well, and more geese than people. The barley stands unfinished in the low field.
The geese scatter. Nobody else looks up.

events.text: You set out on the rutted track north, under oaks that drip on you for company.
Crows argue in the branches overhead.
The road climbs, and the barley country falls away behind you.
The rain finds every gap in your cloak.
The Old Bridge
A stone span over black water, older than the road it carries.
